tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind sheets and slides.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: Document, table and slide surface. Default ground for ink and slate text.

tokens.name: slate-tint
tokens.usage: Neutral diagram block fill and table header ground. Ink text reads on it in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rules, sheet outlines, slide footer rule. Never carries meaning on its own.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and heavy rules (doc header underline). On sheet, paper and slate-tint.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text: doc numbers, captions, footnotes, table headers. On sheet and paper (5.6:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The one accent. Marks, short rules, decision outlines, focus ring. In light theme it is under 4.5:1 on sheet, so small text uses orange-ink.

tokens.name: orange-ink
tokens.usage: Small orange text: slide labels, footnote markers. On sheet and paper.

tokens.name: orange-tint
tokens.usage: Decision block fill in diagrams. Ink text on top.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Permitted path: arrows, status dots, block outlines. Marks only; text uses ok-ink.

tokens.name: ok-ink
tokens.usage: Text on ok-tint and sheet for permitted results.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Permitted or energized block fill.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Inhibit paths, e-stop text and status dots. On sheet and paper.

tokens.name: stop-fill
tokens.usage: The safe state block (0x00 all-off). Text on it uses on-stop-fill.

tokens.name: on-stop-fill
tokens.usage: Text on stop-fill (5.4:1 light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: stop-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet stop background, e.g. a table row that results in all-off.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded states such as FAILSAFE or grace windows. Marks only (dots, outlines); pair with a word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid, 2px offset. 3.3:1 on paper in light theme.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: t-display
styles.usage: Cover and slide titles. Sentence case, never caps.

styles.name: t-h1
styles.usage: Document title in the doc header.

styles.name: t-body
styles.sample: Relays are never commanded from ROS. The link is publish-only.
styles.usage: Running text, max 68 characters a line.

styles.name: t-small
styles.sample: Recovery is automatic; there is no rearm gesture.

styles.name: t-caption
styles.sample: Figure 3. Two scopes, one relay write.
styles.usage: Figure captions ('Figure n.' in 600 ink, text in slate) and footnotes.

styles.name: t-code
styles.usage: Topics, functions, register values, units in tables.

styles.name: t-docno
styles.usage: Document numbers and revisions in doc headers and slide footers.

styles.name: t-label
styles.usage: The only caps style. One short label with open space around it, e.g. above a slide title. Never directly above dense text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip dot gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, label to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between related blocks; diagram dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter; diagram block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; gap between sections in a sheet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sheets; slide inner margin at 960px.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks on long pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Diagram blocks, chips, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Sheets and slides.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Rules and the doc header underline.
